customData.tooltip:
**I have invented this box.** Nothing you have described says Argus waits, gives up, or notices. It may simply take whatever EDGAR returned by the time it got there.

If there is no cutoff, delete this and the flow becomes a straight line — which is itself the finding.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
No Form 4s means no clusters. This scorer does not degrade — it produces nothing.

And nothing downstream distinguishes 'no insider signal' from 'no insider activity', which is the quiet part: an absent detector looks exactly like a calm month.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip:
Loses filing tone, keeps news headlines. Still emits a number — a confident-looking one, from half its evidence.

The only nondeterministic box in the pipeline is also the one that degrades silently rather than failing.

customData.author: agent
customData.tooltip: Combines whatever arrived. On a late day that is three signals instead of four, one of them thinner — and the aggregate carries no record of which.
